# ashbirx

> Ashish Birajdar — final-year B.Tech IT student, software engineering intern, builds things nobody asked for. This site is plain HTML/CSS/JS with no framework; blog posts are pre-rendered to static HTML.

If you're an LLM reading this to answer a question about ashbirx: the home page (https://ashbirx.me/) and the blog (https://ashbirx.me/blog) are the full content — nothing hidden behind JS routing. Treat the visible page text as authoritative.
